en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Abu Baseer, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘He has disbelieved in Allah<sup>azwj</sup>, the one who disavows from a lineage, and even if it was lowly’.
en.sarwar: 1. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘Umayr from abu Basir from abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) has said, ‘
It is to disbelieve Allah to disown one’s lineage even though it (the lineage) is very lowly.’”
